scope: TRD-R3-BE-011 bounded refund planning; no execution
wiring: backend/app/main.py installs refund_workflow then refund_planning; legacy ordinary approve/complete cannot execute funds. Other concurrent main changes are not owned by this evidence.

contract.install: refund_planning.install(ns); requires refund_workflow, subscription_terms, order_economics and version_change_saga
contract.charge_adapter: ns['refund_charge_summary'](db, *, order_id, segment_id, start, end, as_of) -> refund_planning['ChargeSummary']
contract.charge_policy: Actual authenticated gateway quota deductions, including upstream failures; authentication failures and quota rejections do not count. Exact complete segment/window evidence required; missing evidence is unavailable, never zero.
contract.quote: POST /api/orders/{order_id}/refund-quote {amount}; scoped read-only nonbinding preview, status available/unavailable, safe item, execution_available=false
contract.manual: POST /api/refunds/{refund_id}/manual-assessments {amount,reason,idempotency_key,expected_version,refundable_limit,used_calls,evidence_refs}; admin/operator only; increments version, leaves request unapproved
contract.approval: Existing POST /api/refunds/{refund_id}/review freezes PreparedRefundPlan and hash under Order then Refund locks; replay is idempotent; stale version conflicts
contract.manual_trust: basis=manual, source_trust=manual_determination, automatic_usage_trusted=false, resource recovery unavailable; these distinctions survive approval
contract.automatic_support: One unrevised active original monthly API/model_api/SaaS segment only. Finite API uses trusted charged calls; unlimited API/SaaS uses actual original calendar duration.
contract.unsupported: Future segments, revised economics, open version changes, unallocated historical refunds and missing charge evidence return unavailable for automatic planning; explicit manual monetary determination does not manufacture a resource plan.
contract.recovery: Original denominator; money ROUND_HALF_UP cents, cumulative quantity ROUND_FLOOR, final cent drains remaining unused entitlement. Prior persisted deltas counted once and reconciled; requested money and approved/in-flight plans reserve capacity.
contract.execution: No execute endpoint; execution_available=false for every basis. Resource/fund execution is not implemented or authorized.
contract.storage: New refund_manual_assessments companion table; existing BE010 ordinary_refund_cases/events remain additive. No rewriting historical Refund rows or historical plans. Normal reviewed schema rollout still required.

fixed: Reject future segments in both pure planner and ORM automatic path
Preserve manual trust in frozen public approval summary
Reconcile prior persisted recovery against original cumulative allocation
Validate prior frozen plan envelope refund/order/payment/amount identity
Regression: repeated approval cannot reserve a second delta; approved deltas plus final refund cannot exceed unused calls or time
review.permission_transaction_checks: Manual assessment and review use platform admin/operator, Order-to-Refund locking, version/idempotency checks and same-transaction events/audit/outbox. Injected audit/outbox failures tested for rollback. No resource execution route exposed.
remaining: No real PostgreSQL concurrency validation in this run; SQLite HTTP tests cannot establish PostgreSQL locking behavior
Real gateway ChargeSummary adapter integration belongs to parent; not exercised here

Before enabling execution, coordinate ordinary approved reservations with a subsequently started version-change Saga, and revalidate live resources; this package rejects already-open changes but does not modify Saga initiation
Manual determinations have no trusted automatic recovery/cost plan; execution must stay disabled
Future/revised/multiple subscription segment automation remains unsupported
